binding.application: These current working-byte hashes describe the read-only /app workspace bind used by the post-interface unit, migration-resume and demonstration validations. Results are recorded separately by those executions.
binding.git: OID calculated by git hash-object --path <path> <path>, without writing Git objects/index. LF hashes are diagnostic CRLF-to-LF conversions, separate from Git attribute behavior.
binding.runtime: The JVM/runtime dependency image is reused unchanged. This does not claim that image 3cc3b95 has the new interface baked into its /app layer.
binding.tests: The earlier 188-case pass belongs to the before-interface snapshot. This document records source identity, not a pass for post-interface tests still being collected.

interface_origin_verification.identity_semantics: Exact Git blob identity after attributes; working SHA-256 remains separate so CRLF bytes are not misrepresented.

jvm_build_contracts.vendor_verification_method: git diff against the security commit, including worktree/index; vendor files were not recursively rehashed for this document.

scope.selection: Git tracked and non-ignored files under the operational roots, plus the three operational root files. No recursive docs inventory.
